{{Quote|We're almost through! Bring in the flamethrowers!|[[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]]|<ref name="Landing at Point Rain">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref>}}
The '''BT X-42 heavy flamethrower''', also known as the '''clone flamethrower''', was a type of [[Flamethrower/Legends|flame-projecting]] weapon developed for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Used by the [[Flame trooper/Legends|clone flame troopers]], they were designed for use against unarmored targets, such as [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Warrior caste (Geonosian)/Legends|warriors]] during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]]. It was also used by the [[Mandalorian Royal Guard/Legends|Mandalorian Royal Guard]].

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Flamethrower-SWG.png|thumb|187px|Flamethrower from ''Star Wars Galaxies''.]]
Apart from the vertical carrying handle, the BT X-42 is identical to the flamethrower model used in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.
